assets.caption: The scene is an interior view of a functional and robust gym, presented in a realistic style, conveying a no-frills, dedicated atmosphere focused on serious training. The overall tone is gritty and determined, reflecting the raw energy of a traditional weightlifting environment. The floor is covered with dark, durable rubber matting, designed to withstand heavy impact from weights and provide a stable surface. Along the long walls, a continuous series of framed pictures and dark wood paneling creates a classic, established aesthetic, with mirrors interspersed, reflecting the rows of exercise equipment. Overhead, industrial fluorescent lights provide bright, uniform illumination, complemented by several ceiling fans for air circulation. Various types of weightlifting equipment, including benches, racks, and machines, are arranged systematically throughout the space, optimized for full-body workouts. The equipment is predominantly white and blue, contrasting with the dark flooring and wood paneling. Dumbbells and barbells of varying weights are neatly organized on racks, indicating a well-maintained and extensive collection. A large American flag is prominently displayed on one wall, adding a patriotic touch to the space. The 360 scene is faultless.
